testcase.name: Scenario: Toggle a nested sketch and its dimension visibility: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:697:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Toggle a nested sketch and its dimension visibility ✔ Given the MCAD Software has a rectangular dimensioned sketch consumed by an extrusion ✔ And the sketch is hidden and its Dimension Visibility setting is enabled ✔ When the user chooses Visibility from the sketch row context menu ✔ Then the sketch is visible and its dimension annotations appear ✔ When the user clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the dimension annotations remain visible ✔ When the user reopens the sketch context menu ✔ Then Visibility and Dimension Visibility are checked ✔ When the user chooses Dimension Visibility ✔ Then the dimension annotations disappear while the sketch remains visible ✔ When the user reopens the sketch context menu ✔ Then Visibility is checked and Dimension Visibility is unchecked ✔ When the user chooses Dimension Visibility again ✔ Then the dimension annotations reappear ✔ When the user chooses Visibility from the sketch context menu ✔ Then the sketch and its annotations are hidden again ✔ And the shaded solid remains visible
